en.headline: Abby Choi murder trial to open at High Court this week
en.dek: The ex-husband, father-in-law and brother-in-law of the late model face a joint murder charge; the first hearing is set for Monday with the case expected to last about 45 days.
body: The High Court murder trial of three former relatives of socialite and model Abby Choi Tin-fung is due to begin this week, more than three years after her death.

Choi’s former husband Alex Kwong Kong-chi, 31, his father Kwong Kau, 68, and elder brother Anthony Kwong Kong-kit, 35, face a joint count of murder and a charge of preventing the lawful burial of a body.

The first trial hearing is scheduled for Monday for preliminary matters. Jury selection is expected later in the week, after which the prosecution will deliver its opening speech. The trial is expected to run for about 45 days.

Choi, 28, was reported missing in February 2023. Parts of her dismembered body were later found in a village house in Lung Mei Tsuen, Tai Po. The three defendants have been in custody since their arrests that month.
The case drew widespread attention in Hong Kong and overseas. The Judiciary has made arrangements for public seating given the expected interest.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案下週高院開審 前夫等三人被控謀殺
zh.dek: 蔡天鳳前夫、前家翁及前大伯被控謀殺及阻止合法殮葬，周一先處理程序事宜，全案料審約45日。
body: 社交名媛兼模特兒蔡天鳳被殺案，三名前親屬的高等法院謀殺案將於本週開審，距離事發已超過三年。
蔡天鳳前夫鄺港智（31歲）、前家翁鄺裘（68歲）及前大伯鄺港傑（35歲）被控一項謀殺罪，以及一項阻止合法殮葬屍體罪。
案件周一先在高院處理程序事宜，稍後選出陪審團，控方其後作開案陳詞。全案預計審理約45日。
蔡天鳳於2023年2月報失，其後在大埔龍尾村一村屋發現被肢解遺體部分。三名被告自被捕後一直還押。
案件曾引起本地及海外廣泛關注，司法機構已因應預期公眾興趣安排旁聽座位。
